text_en: Playing record STC-002C2JJ93.
43:01. You're one minute late.
S-sorry.
Punctuality is basic.
I'll be careful.
Today I'll train you on escape situation simulations.
Look at the prisoner in front of you.
There are prisoners who attempt escape through illicit means like this one.
When they try to open the door a simple warning is enough to stop them.
Pull the marked lever.
This lever up on the right?
Good.
You don't need to worry about a subdued prisoner like this. The system will automatically reproduce them.
Let's move on.
If you fail to stop the lockpicking you'll need to cut off the escape route.
A disrespectful prisoner is best blown away.
Enter ABAB on the button in front of you.
Whoa that's cool!
This is Alien technology for you.
It might be hard for that little red brain of yours to understand.
Let's move on.
A fleeing prisoner can also be subdued another way.
Open the fridge behind you.
A gun?
It's a beverage provided for staff welfare but
it can also be used as suppression equipment.
Grab the gun take out a can and load it.
A gun that fires pickle soda...
How crude. This converts pickle energy into an Aura projectile.
Hit the fleeing prisoner.
Whoa.
This equipment can subdue prisoners in most situations.
If your aim were any better than yours this alone could wipe out a whole squad of Triplefang.
Well this might be enough but
if you fail to stop them running the prisoner will head for the escape hatch.
Move to the 1st floor for an accurate demonstration.
Got it!
Move to the 1st floor.
If you fail to stop the escape they'll come here.
This requires a more complex process
the marked equipment behind you is the BIN the Biowaste Incineration Network.
Throw away trash from your shift like pickle soda cans or paper in here.
Let's throw one away.
See the count go up on the screen?
This device requires at least 4 pieces of trash to operate.
What if there's no trash?
Pickle juice is provided infinitely so use that.
Now activate the BIN's lever.
Once the BIN activates a HORSE will be generated.
For reference HORSE stands for Hybrid Operational Riot Suppression Entity.
Operate the marked pump repeatedly to subdue the prisoner.
Faster!
Your physical ability is below expectations too.
You barely cleared the evaluation standard.
Well that's everything.
Don't we need to watch the vents or ceiling too?
Ha why afraid a prisoner might fly away?
Prisoners can't fly so watching this hatch alone should be enough.
Uh... behind you sir...
Wha- What!
That's it for today's shift. System!
Ending shift.
That last scene is still funny even thinking back on it.
Terribly incompetent. It's ABAB. Try again.
